title: managed-upstream-keys-push-v1
description: The value of managed_models.upstream_keys in a pushed org config, keyed by managed provider id. It exists only in the push payload: never stored in AgentccOrgConfig, never returned by a read, never in config history. A save that contains it is 400 secret_in_config. The gateway uses it only in managed.upstream_key_mode per_org or per_org_with_shared_fallback.
